instruction: can i still cancel an order placed this morning
response: Possibly. Send me the order number and I will check whether it has entered fulfilment, then tell you the cancellation options that apply.

instruction: the password reset email never reached me
response: Check the spam folder first, then confirm the email address on the account. If it is still missing I will look at whether the reset message was sent.

instruction: the item never arrived and i want a refund
response: I am sorry it did not arrive. Give me the order number and I will open a missing parcel case, which is the step that leads to a refund or a replacement.

instruction: the tracking page says nothing for two days
response: That usually means the carrier has not scanned the parcel recently. Share the order number and I will check what the latest carrier update shows.
